newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH '96 TIMBER PURCHASES DOWN 10 PCT - METLA.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH '96 TIMBER PURCHASES DOWN 10 PCT - METLA.

text.p: Industry's raw timber purchases from private Finnish forests fell 10 percent to 32.5 million cubic metres in 1996 on 1995, the Finnish Forest Research Institute (METLA) said in a monthly review on Wednesday.
"1996 timber purchases correspond to about 40 million cubic metres of cut wood," it said.
"The 1996 purchase volume was the third largest in history," it said, adding that timber purchases had exceeded 30 million cubic metres only in 1994-96 and in 1988 and 1989.

December 1996 timber markings rose to 4.0 million cubic metres from 2.4 million in December a year ago, but they fell from 4.8 million cubic metres in November, METLA said in a separate monthly review.
Total timber markings in 1996 fell 19 percent to 25 million cubic metres from 30.7 million cubic metres in 1995, METLA said.
